Frequently Asked Questions

View full FAQ
I can't join a space. It sends me back home.
  • Check the room link is complete: /room/<room-id>.
  • Confirm the room still exists with the host.
  • Refresh and retry, then try a private window if needed.
Connection drops and I get "Connection lost."
  • Wait briefly for auto-reconnect.
  • Refresh and rejoin if it doesn't recover.
  • Switch to a more stable network and close duplicate room tabs.
It says "Incorrect password" or keeps asking for password.
  • Re-enter carefully (case and spacing).
  • Confirm password with host.
  • Use a fresh invite link.
I entered my name, but I still don't connect.
  • Check internet, disable VPN/proxy temporarily.
  • Refresh and retry.
  • Try another browser (Chrome/Edge).
Can I use Quran Space without signing in?
  • Yes. Guests can create and join spaces directly.
  • Signing in helps save spaces and settings.
  • You can continue as guest and sign in later.
Which code should I share with students?
  • Share the room code shown after you create a space.
  • If your room has a password, share that separately.
  • Avoid sharing owner-only links in public chats.
